sourceText:
Meu Teste
By: Tasty Trix
Published: Saturday, June 26, 2010 - 6:50am

Ingredients




1 bunch flowering kale, shredded
10 pieces garlic scapes, chopped
2 cups day old jasmine rice
1 tablespoon sesame oil
1 tablespoon peanut oil
2 tablespoons oyster sauce
1 dashes soy sauce
1/2 teaspoon white pepper
2 green onions
3 eggs

Preparation

1 Saute the kale and garlic scapes over medium high heat  in half the oil until the kale wilts, set aside 2 Toss the rice in the pan with the remaining oil, reserving just a bit of oil, until the rice is warm 3 Meanwhile, scramble 3 eggs in the reserved oil a separate pan 4 Add the kale and garlic scapes back to the rice, adding the oyster sauce, soy sauce, and white pepper 5 Fold in the scrambled eggs 6 Serve garnished with the green onions

About


A simple and flavorful way to use garlic scapes
